behavioral_gaps.spec_requirement: Event stream cursor persisted and replayed
behavioral_gaps.summary: ResyncHandler has no unit tests in internal/events/. The handler is wired in daemon/run.go but never exercised; its reconciliation walk (orchestrators -> roles -> end-vanished-bindings) is unverified at this layer.
behavioral_gaps.fix: Add TestResync_EndsVanishedBindings that seeds bindings for present + absent tasks against a fake argus serving GET /api/tasks, fires a resync event, and asserts the vanished binding ended with end_reason=resync_missing.

behavioral_gaps.spec_requirement: Auto-adopt copies mission and constraints from task meta
behavioral_gaps.summary: No test asserts that when meta:hera.role=worker is present but meta:hera.mission and meta:hera.constraints are absent, the created role's Mission and Constraints columns are empty strings (per spec: 'not NULL'). The happy path sets both; the missing-role test exits before Create.
behavioral_gaps.fix: Add TestAdopt_MissionConstraintsAbsent_EmptyStrings that sets only meta:hera.role=worker and asserts role.Mission == "" && role.Constraints == "" after adoption.

contradictions.summary: Spec requires the skipped-adoption INFO log to include 'the new task's id, the parent task's id, and the missing meta key'. The meta-value-not-worker branch logs only `child` and `value` (no `parent`, no structured `missing_key`). The missing-role-meta branch (line 81-83) does include `parent`.
contradictions.fix: Either (a) update adopt.go:86-88 to add parent=link.Parent and missing_key=MetaKeyRole to the log attributes, or (b) interpret the spec as covering only the strictly-missing case and clarify the wording. Recommended: option (a) for symmetry.

test_alignment_gaps.spec_requirement: Event stream cursor persisted and replayed
test_alignment_gaps.summary: ResyncHandler is entirely untested in this module. Spec scenario maps to live code but no assertion exists.
test_alignment_gaps.fix: Create resync_test.go covering: (1) ResyncHandler ignores non-resync events; (2) on resync, ListTasks is called; (3) bindings whose ArgusTaskID is absent from the live list are ended with end_reason=resync_missing; (4) bindings whose tasks are still present are left alone.

test_alignment_gaps.summary: Neither skipped-adoption test asserts that an INFO log was emitted, nor that the log carries the spec-mandated fields (child id, parent id, missing meta key). Spec wording on log content is unverified.
test_alignment_gaps.fix: Use a slog.Handler wired to a capture buffer in setupAdopt, then assert the captured records contain Level=Info and the expected attrs after the skipped-adoption call.

test_alignment_gaps.spec_scenario: Meta present, parent link absent - not adopted
test_alignment_gaps.summary: The test fires a link.created event with an unbound parent, which exercises the parent-binding-not-found branch. Spec scenario describes task.created with hera.role=worker and NO link.created naming the task. The test verifies the same outcome (no adoption) but via a different code path. Coverage of the spec's exact preconditions is missing.
test_alignment_gaps.fix: Either rename the test to reflect what it actually covers, or add a second test where only task.created fires (no link.created) and verify no adoption occurred. Note: the implementation listens for link.created exclusively; the absence of a link.created event is implicitly handled by never triggering the handler at all.
